# The actual negative submodule generated by the pure-V homotopy image

## Theorem and boundary

Retain the conditional pure-V Q-compatible radical hypothesis and canonical
homotopy h of PR1048. Use only linear forms in the fixed negative two-space
W. Define actual subspaces of the three original module degrees by

    F2=im h,
    F3=sum over l in W of X_l(F2),
    F4=sum over a in Sym^2 W of T_a(F2).

Then F=(F2,F3,F4) is a genuine fixed-variable negative submodule, and
Q(F2) is contained in F4. Its first two spaces have EXACT characters

    F2=P+D,           F3=W'+2T,

and dimensions(9,14). On the projective line P(W), its universal first
arrow has cokernel

    coker[F2 O(−1)→F3 O]=O(5) direct-sum P O(1).             (1)

This is a statement about the actual restricted first arrows, not an
identification of the whole three-space module with another known module.

The last space lies in ker h, contains I4=im j4=P, and satisfies the exact
presentation

    Sym^2 W tensor P_h → F4/I4 →0,                          (2)

where P_h is the canonical P-isotypical summand of F2. Consequently

    F4 has character P+epsilon_V V+epsilon_P P+epsilon_D D,
    each epsilon is0 or1,                                  (3)

and its necessary dimension list is

    {4,7,8,9,11,12,13,16}.

These are only necessary endpoint alternatives, not claims that all are
realized or that the generated target fills ker h. The remaining quadratic
relations are retained as the kernel of (2).

If the smallest alternative F4=I4 holds, every original D class has a
formal lift inside this submodule for the entire negative-quadratic formal
family. All its later Bockstein obstructions vanish. The original37-minors
then vanish identically on Q+Sym^2 W, and the generic original rank on
this affine family is exactly36. This is conditional, not a selection of
that endpoint alternative or of actual lift coefficients.

Here B denotes the vector bundle called Q in the negative-pencil

## 2. The complete first-multiplication kernel

The actual bundle B has an equivariant bundle splitting

    B ≅ (P+D)O(2) direct-sum A O(6) direct-sum O(18).          (4)

Indeed PR790 gives the genuine first block and an exact residual bundle
sequence dual to 0→A O(−6)→R→O(−18)→0. Its extension group is
H1(A O(12))=0, so it splits equivariantly as a BUNDLE. We use (4) only
to compute cohomology of B; it is not declared a horizontal decomposition
of the residual embedding, nor a splitting of the second arrows.

Tensor the complete degree-one evaluation sequence by B(−2):

    0→B(−3)→W tensor B(−2)→B(−1)→0.

Since the least line degree of B(−3) in (4) is−1, its H1 vanishes.
The actual first arrows therefore give a surjective multiplication map

    m:W tensor N2→N3,
    ker m=H0(B(−3))=A tensor Sym3 W + Sym15 W.

The binary-icosahedral identities are

    A tensor Sym3 W=W+S+T,       Sym15 W=S+2T.

Thus

    ker m=W+2S+3T.                                          (5)

These identify the character of the ACTUAL kernel using an exact sequence,
not merely subtracting abstract endpoint dimensions.

The pure-V image multiplication W tensor I2→I3 is onto, with kernel S,
because it is ordinary Sym1 W tensor Sym4 W→Sym5 W. Comparing it with m
and taking the quotient U=N/I gives a surjective map

    bar m:W tensor U2→U3,
    ker bar m=(ker m)/S=W+S+3T.                              (6)

The exact kernel quotient in (6) follows from the snake lemma and the
surjectivity of the image multiplication. In particular ker bar m has
NO W' constituent.

## 3. Why the generated middle space is exactly fourteen-dimensional

Write F2=D direct-sum P_h using its two inequivalent isotypical summands.
This is canonical within im h, and is not a choice of an arbitrary P in
N2. Its image bar P_h in U2 is an embedded copy of P, since F2 intersect
I2=D.

Restrict bar m to

    W tensor bar P_h = W'+T.

Its kernel is a subrepresentation of (6). Hence that kernel cannot contain
W'. If it were nonzero, irreducibility would force it to contain the
entire six-dimensional T, leaving total image dimension at most2.
But PR963 supplies injectivity of the actual first arrow U2→U3 for every
negative linear form off D12. Restricting such an arrow to the embedded
four-space bar P_h is injective. Its image is contained in the image of
bar m on W tensor bar P_h, forcing that image dimension at least4.
This contradiction proves

    W tensor bar P_h → U3 is injective.                     (7)

The argument uses an everywhere-off-divisor theorem, not evaluation at
any selected direction. The original first arrows are also injective for
every nonzero linear form by their actual H0(B(−2)) multiplication
realization; neither injectivity statement is inferred from characters.

Since X_W D=I3=T, (7) implies both injectivity of W tensor P_h→N3 and
zero intersection of its image with I3. Therefore

    F3=I3 direct-sum X_W P_h ≅ T direct-sum (W tensor P),

proving its character W'+2T and dimension14.

Under this actual direct sum, the restricted first-arrow system is the
sum of ordinary binary multiplication Sym4 W→Sym5 W and the free system
P→W tensor P. Their universal exact sequences on P(W) are

    0→D O(−1)→T O→O(5)→0,
    0→P O(−1)→(W tensor P)O→P O(1)→0.

This proves (1) with its stated twists. Its rank is5 and degree9, agreeing
with the source9 O(−1) and target14 O. The bundle B itself is shifted in
its reconstruction and is not being identified with this cokernel.

## 4. Generated target, exact residual relations, and Q stability

Commutativity of the original negative linear multiplication gives

    Y_W F3=T_(Sym²W) F2=F4.

Thus F is a genuine submodule. The sandwich theorem hT_a h=0 shows
F4 is contained in ker h. Also T_(Sym²W)D=I4 by PR792. Since Q(F2)=I4,
the two endpoint spaces form a Q-stable subcomplex, with no requirement
that Q act on the middle degree.

Modulo I4, only P_h generators remain, proving the exact surjection (2).
Because

    Sym²W tensor P=V+P+D

is multiplicity-free, its actual kernel is a sum of some of these three
irreducibles. Equivariant semisimplicity then gives (3). This bounds
F4 by dimension16, not28. The twenty-eight-dimensional space ker h from
PR1048 is only an ambient container.

More explicitly let R2 be the kernel of the concrete surjection

    I4 direct-sum (Sym²W tensor P_h)→F4,
    (v,a tensor p) maps to v+T_a p.

Its intersection with I4 is zero. Projection identifies R2 with the
kernel of (2); any graph component into I4 can involve only its P
constituent. This retains the possible quadratic relations and possible
intersection of T_(Sym²W)P_h with I4. The proof does NOT assert that any
of its V,P,D channels is nonzero, or assign the P graph scalar. Determining
those actual embedded channels is the remaining endpoint problem.

## 5. Conditional consequence of the smallest generated endpoint

Suppose F4=I4. The restriction Q:P_h→I4 is an isomorphism, since Q(F2)=I4
and its kernel in F2 is exactly D. Let s:I4→P_h be its inverse. For a
formal negative quadratic perturbation Z=sum z_i T_i, the submodule gives
Z(F2) subset I4. Hence on F2→I4,

    M=Q+Z,        M s=1+Zs

is formally onto, with formal right inverse s(1+Zs)^(-1). For every d in D,

    d(z)=d−s(1+Zs)^(-1) M d

satisfies Md(z)=0 and d(0)=d. This is a simultaneous formal lift of all
five independent original D classes. No eigenvalue or source coefficient
is evaluated, and no formal direct summand of the entire graded module
is inferred.

Over the fraction field of the formal power-series ring, these five
independent lifts force the original41-to37 map to have rank at most36.
Its37-minors are polynomials in z_i; their vanishing in the formal field
makes them polynomial identities. Thus the bound holds throughout the
affine family Q+Sym²W, including outside the formal neighborhood.
The invariant rank33 and generic rank3 original second symbol on A give
a generic lower bound36 (three nonzero valuation-two Smith factors), so
the affine-family generic rank is exactly36.

All D obstructions vanish along every one-parameter negative direction.
In particular the original fourth on D vanishes; PR1025 then gives zero
for the canonical two-channel quadratic lift. The converse is not asserted.
Neither the smallest endpoint alternative nor any other endpoint rank is
selected, so this is not a source exclusion or complete repair.

## Reproduction

Run `python verify.py` or `python -O verify.py`. The checker authenticates
five inputs, verifies representation identities through the McKay recurrence,
checks the Koszul character calculations and necessary endpoint list,
verifies full symbolic first-arrow minors and evaluation rows, and checks
the formal right-inverse kernel-graph identity. All assertions are enforced
by explicit exceptions. The actual sheaf and corrected-map arguments are
in the proof; no actual HM instance, coefficient or point is evaluated.
